objective: Reconstruct a bounded TED eForms notice lifecycle from frozen XML and produce immutable Evidence Objects, deterministic sandbox admission decisions and a traceable procurement dossier without enabling product or canonical authority.
outcome: A version-pinned lifecycle supports initial CN16, correction, notice cancellation and CAN29 result notices; validates procedure, lot and previous-notice lineage; emits hashed Evidence Objects and a deterministic dossier; and proves blocking, replay and rollback.

skills.activation_reason: Bind every observed claim to notice-version XML and immutable evidence.
Apply deterministic sandbox admission after independent reparse and lineage validation.
Model correction, notice cancellation, result, lot and contract lifecycle semantics.
Exclude personal contact values from claims, dossiers and CI evidence.
Prove lineage rejection, deterministic replay, rollback and dossier stability.
Keep TECHNICAL_PROBE, sandbox and PRODUCT_ADMITTED states distinct.

external: OP-TED eForms SDK 1.14.2 change and competition-result structures

allowed_scope: Frozen synthetic XML using official eForms structures
prohibited_scope: Production database, queue or ResearchRun wiring
Personal contact values in claims or artifacts
Supplier suitability, win probability or profitability claims
Public claim that procurement is a supported universe

acceptance_evidence.description: Versioned lifecycle, evidence, admission and dossier profile.
Tests cover full lifecycle, cancellation semantics, dangling references, unknown lots, privacy, replay and rollback.
Non-sensitive CI evidence reports hashes, counts, state and zero canonical writes.
Runbook records lifecycle semantics, authority boundaries and promotion blockers.

rollback.strategy: Remove lifecycle rehearsal code and CI wiring while preserving the frozen parser, task record and aggregate hashes.
rollback.kill_switch: TED and its claim policy remain disabled outside the CI sandbox.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The lifecycle advances global discovery to official evidence and results.
Every claim is linked to a notice reference, XML hash, source path and Evidence Object.
Lot, procedure, award and timeline semantics remain usable by Globe, Graph and Timeline.
No user-interest signal participates in lifecycle truth.
Original source values and language-sensitive names remain hashed and traceable without lossy translation.
Versioned lineage and immutable evidence increase differentiation from generic summarisation.
The dossier explicitly excludes suitability, bidding, profitability and personalised advice.
The actual source gate blocks admission and personal values are excluded.
The sandbox is removable and forced failure proves zero residual state.
It directly advances the authorised procurement lineage and admission gate.
